name: 19428 · Conshohocken, PA
findings: ZIP 19428 (Conshohocken) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19428 (Conshohocken) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19428 (Conshohocken) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
